description: This Python source file defines various utility functions and scripts for handling graph break registry management in the PyTorch Dynamo project. It includes functions for loading, saving, and generating IDs for a registry, processing source code strings, expanding hints, and extracting information from AST nodes related to unimplemented function calls, as well as a main function to facilitate registry creation.

methods.name: str|None get_source_segment(source: str, node: ast.AST)
methods.description: Retrieves source code segment corresponding to an AST node from the source string.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] load_registry(path: Path)
methods.description: Loads a registry dictionary from a JSON file path if it exists.

methods.name: None save_registry(reg: dict[str, Any], path: Path)
methods.description: Saves a registry dictionary to a JSON file at the specified path.

methods.name: str next_gb_id(reg: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Generates a unique 'GB' ID within the range GB0000-GB9999 that is not used in the registry.

methods.name: Any clean_string(s: Any)
methods.description: Normalizes string literals by removing formatting artifacts, escape sequences, and other syntax elements.

methods.name: list[str] expand_hints(hints: list[str], dynamo_dir: str | None = None)
methods.description: Expands hint references to their actual values by executing the hints source code and substituting known constants.

methods.name: Any extract_info_from_keyword(source: str, kw: ast.keyword)
methods.description: Extracts and reconstructs the value of a keyword argument from an AST node, handling constants, f-strings, and other expressions.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] find_unimplemented_calls( path: str, dynamo_dir: str | None = None )
methods.description: Scans Python files in a directory or single file for calls to unimplemented functions, returning info for registry creation.

methods.name: None create_registry(dynamo_dir: str, registry_path: str)
methods.description: Creates a registry JSON file by analyzing unimplemented calls in a directory and assigning sequential IDs.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Entry point for the script, parsing command-line arguments and invoking creation of the registry.

ctags.name: expand_hints
ctags.pattern: /^def expand_hints(hints: list[str], dynamo_dir: str | None = None) -> list[str]:$/

ctags.name: find_unimplemented_calls
ctags.signature: ( path: str, dynamo_dir: str | None = None )

ctags.name: get_source_segment
ctags.pattern: /^def get_source_segment(source: str, node: ast.AST) -> str | None:$/

ctags.name: save_registry
ctags.pattern: /^def save_registry(reg: dict[str, Any], path: Path) -> None:$/
